verses.ar: اِقۡتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيۡ غَفۡلَةٍ مُّعۡرِضُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: The reckoning of the people has drawn near to them, while they are in negligence, turning away (from its signs).

verses.ar: مَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ ذِكۡرٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡ مُّحۡدَثٍ اِلَّا اسۡتَمَعُوۡهُ وَهُمۡ يَلۡعَبُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: No fresh message of advice comes to them from their Lord, but they listen to it as if they were playing,

verses.ar: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوۡبُهُمۡؕ وَاَسَرُّوا النَّجۡوَيࣗۖ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡاࣗۖ هَلۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡۚ اَفَتَاۡتُوۡنَ السِّحۡرَ وَاَنۡتُمۡ تُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: their hearts paying no heed. And the wrongdoers whisper in secret, “This one is nothing but a mortal like you. Would you then go along with sorcery while you can see (the reality)?”

verses.ar: قٰلَ رَبِّيۡ يَعۡلَمُ الۡقَوۡلَ فِي السَّمَآءِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؗ وَهُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
verses.en: He (the prophet) said, “My Lord knows all that is spoken in the heavens and the earth, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.”

verses.ar: بَلۡ قَالُوۡ٘ا اَضۡغَاثُ اَحۡلَامٍۭ بَلِ افۡتَرٰىهُ بَلۡ هُوَ شَاعِرٌۚۖ فَلۡيَاۡتِنَا بِاٰيَةٍ كَمَا٘ اُرۡسِلَ الۡاَوَّلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Further they said, “(The Qur’ān is) a mixture of jumble dreams. Rather, he (the prophet) has fabricated it. Rather, he is a poet. So, let him bring a sign to us, as the earlier ones were sent with.”

verses.ar: مَا٘ اٰمَنَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ اَهۡلَكۡنٰهَاۚ اَفَهُمۡ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: Not a single town from those whom We destroyed came to believe before them. So, will they believe?

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ اِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوۡحِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡهِمۡ فَسۡـَٔلُوۡ٘ا اَهۡلَ الذِّكۡرِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: And We did not send before you messengers except men whom We inspired with revelation. So, ask the people (having the knowledge) of the Message, if you do not know.

verses.ar: وَمَا جَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ جَسَدًا لَّا يَاۡكُلُوۡنَ الطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوۡا خٰلِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: We did not make them such bodies as ate no food, nor were they immortal.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ صَدَقۡنٰهُمُ الۡوَعۡدَ فَاَنۡجَيۡنٰهُمۡ وَمَنۡ نَّشَآءُ وَاَهۡلَكۡنَا الۡمُسۡرِفِيۡنَ
verses.en: Then We caused the promise to come true for them, so We saved them and those whom We willed, and destroyed the transgressors.

verses.ar: لَقَدۡ اَنۡزَلۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكُمۡ كِتٰبًا فِيۡهِ ذِكۡرُكُمۡؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Surely, We have sent down to you (O people of Arabia) a book having a good counsel for you. So, do you not understand?

verses.ar: وَكَمۡ قَصَمۡنَا مِنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ كَانَتۡ ظَالِمَةً وَّاَنۡشَاۡنَا بَعۡدَهَا قَوۡمًا اٰخَرِيۡنَ
verses.en: How many a town, that were unjust, have We crushed and raised up after them another people!

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا٘ اَحَسُّوۡا بَاۡسَنَا٘ اِذَا هُمۡ مِّنۡهَا يَرۡكُضُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: So, as soon as they sensed Our punishment (approaching them), they started fleeing from it.

verses.ar: لَا تَرۡكُضُوۡا وَارۡجِعُوۡ٘ا اِلٰي مَا٘ اُتۡرِفۡتُمۡ فِيۡهِ وَمَسٰكِنِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ
verses.en: (It was said to them,) “Do not flee, and go back to the luxuries you were made to enjoy, and to your dwellings. May be you are asked questions.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰوَيۡلَنَا٘ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “Alas for us! We were wrongdoers indeed.”

verses.ar: فَمَا زَالَتۡ تِّلۡكَ دَعۡوٰىهُمۡ حَتّٰي جَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ حَصِيۡدًا خٰمِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: Then, this continued to be their cry till We turned them into stubble, totally extinguished.

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا السَّمَآءَ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لٰعِبِيۡنَ
verses.en: We did not create the heavens and the earth and what lies between them for play.

verses.ar: لَوۡ اَرَدۡنَا٘ اَنۡ نَّتَّخِذَ لَهۡوًا لَّاتَّخَذۡنٰهُ مِنۡ لَّدُنَّا٘ࣗۖ اِنۡ كُنَّا فٰعِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: Had We intended to have a pastime, We would have had it from Our own, if We were ever to do so.

verses.ar: بَلۡ نَقۡذِفُ بِالۡحَقِّ عَلَي الۡبَاطِلِ فَيَدۡمَغُهٗ فَاِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌؕ وَلَكُمُ الۡوَيۡلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُوۡنَ
verses.en: Instead, We launch the truth against falsehood, which gets it smashed, and in no time it is gone. Alas to you for what you describe!

verses.ar: وَلَهٗ مَنۡ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ وَمَنۡ عِنۡدَهٗ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِهٖ وَلَا يَسۡتَحۡسِرُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: To Him belong all those in the heavens and the earth. And those who are near to Him are not arrogant against His worship, nor are they sluggish.

verses.ar: يُسَبِّحُوۡنَ الَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَ لَا يَفۡتُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: They proclaim His purity night and day, never slackening.

verses.ar: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوۡ٘ا اٰلِهَةً مِّنَ الۡاَرۡضِ هُمۡ يُنۡشِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Or have they adopted gods from the earth, who raise the dead?

verses.ar: لَوۡ كَانَ فِيۡهِمَا٘ اٰلِهَةٌ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ لَفَسَدَتَاۚ فَسُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ رَبِّ الۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوۡنَ
verses.en: Had there been gods beside Allah, in the heavens and the earth, both of them would have fallen in disorder. So pure is Allah, the Lord of the Throne, from what they describe.

verses.ar: لَا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفۡعَلُ وَهُمۡ يُسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ
verses.en: He is not questioned of what He does, and they are questioned.

verses.ar: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اٰلِهَةًؕ قُلۡ هَاتُوۡا بُرۡهَانَكُمۡۚ هٰذَا ذِكۡرُ مَنۡ مَّعِيَ وَذِكۡرُ مَنۡ قَبۡلِيۡؕ بَلۡ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ الۡحَقَّ فَهُمۡ مُّعۡرِضُوۡنَ
verses.en: Is it that they have adopted gods besides Him? Say, “Bring your proof.” Here is the (book carrying) advice for those with me, and the (books carrying) advice for those before me. Yet most of them do not know the truth, and therefore they are averse.

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ مِنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا نُوۡحِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡهِ اَنَّهٗ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا٘ اَنَا فَاعۡبُدُوۡنِ
verses.en: We did not send before you any messenger but We revealed to him that there is no god but I, so worship Me.”

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَلَدًا سُبۡحٰنَهٗؕ بَلۡ عِبَادٌ مُّكۡرَمُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: They said, “The RaHmān (the All-Merciful, Allah) has taken children for Himself.” Pure is He (from having children). They are but (His) honored servants.

verses.ar: لَا يَسۡبِقُوۡنَهٗ بِالۡقَوۡلِ وَهُمۡ بِاَمۡرِهٖ يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: They do not precede Him in speech, and only under His command they act.

verses.ar: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَلَا يَشۡفَعُوۡنَۙ اِلَّا لِمَنِ ارۡتَضٰي وَهُمۡ مِّنۡ خَشۡيَتِهٖ مُشۡفِقُوۡنَ
verses.en: He knows what is in front of them and what is behind them, and they make recommendation for none but for whom He likes, and in awe of Him they are fearful.

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ يَّقُلۡ مِنۡهُمۡ اِنِّيۡ٘ اِلٰهٌ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ فَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِيۡهِ جَهَنَّمَؕ كَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي الظّٰلِمِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Should any one of them say, “I am god besides Him”, We will recompense him with Jahannam (Hell). This is how We recompense the transgressors.

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اَنَّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ كَانَتَا رَتۡقًا فَفَتَقۡنٰهُمَاؕ وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنَ الۡمَآءِ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ حَيٍّؕ اَفَلَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: Did the disbelievers not observe that the heavens and the earth were closed, then We opened them? And We created from water every living thing. Would they still not believe?

verses.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ رَوَاسِيَ اَنۡ تَمِيۡدَ بِهِمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيۡهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: And We created mountains on the earth, lest it should shake with them, and We have made therein paths and ways, so that they are guided.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا السَّمَآءَ سَقۡفًا مَّحۡفُوۡظًاۚۖ وَّهُمۡ عَنۡ اٰيٰتِهَا مُعۡرِضُوۡنَ
verses.en: We made the sky a protected roof; and they are averse to its signs.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ الَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَالشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَؕ كُلٌّ فِيۡ فَلَكٍ يَّسۡبَحُوۡنَ
verses.en: He is the One who has created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon, each floating in an orbit.

verses.ar: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِكَ الۡخُلۡدَؕ اَفَا۠ئِنۡ مِّتَّ فَهُمُ الۡخٰلِدُوۡنَ
verses.en: We did not assign immortality to any human (even) before you. So, if you die, will they live for ever?

verses.ar: كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ الۡمَوۡتِؕ وَنَبۡلُوۡكُمۡ بِالشَّرِّ وَالۡخَيۡرِ فِتۡنَةًؕ وَاِلَيۡنَا تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: Every one has to taste death, and We test you through bad and good (situations) with a trial, and to Us you are to be returned.

verses.ar: وَاِذَا رَاٰكَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ يَّتَّخِذُوۡنَكَ اِلَّا هُزُوًاؕ اَهٰذَا الَّذِيۡ يَذۡكُرُ اٰلِهَتَكُمۡۚ وَهُمۡ بِذِكۡرِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ هُمۡ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: When disbelievers see you, they do nothing but take you in jest (saying to one another,) “Is this the one who talks of your gods?” - while they themselves reject even talking of the RaHmān (All-Merciful).

verses.ar: خُلِقَ الۡاِنۡسَانُ مِنۡ عَجَلٍؕ سَاُورِيۡكُمۡ اٰيٰتِيۡ فَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنِ
verses.en: Man is made of haste. I shall show you My signs, so do not seek haste from Me.

verses.ar: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الۡوَعۡدُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: They say, “When will this promise be (fulfilled), if you are true?”

verses.ar: لَوۡ يَعۡلَمُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا حِيۡنَ لَا يَكُفُّوۡنَ عَنۡ وُّجُوۡهِهِمُ النَّارَ وَلَا عَنۡ ظُهُوۡرِهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنۡصَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Only if the disbelievers were to know the time when they will not (be able to) keep off the fire from their faces or from their backs, nor will they be helped.

verses.ar: بَلۡ تَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ بَغۡتَةً فَتَبۡهَتُهُمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنۡظَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Rather, it will come upon them suddenly and will baffle them. So they will not be able to turn it back, nor will they be given respite.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدِ اسۡتُهۡزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِالَّذِيۡنَ سَخِرُوۡا مِنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: In fact, messengers have been mocked at prior to you. So those who laughed at them were besieged by what they used to ridicule.

verses.ar: قُلۡ مَنۡ يَّكۡلَؤُكُمۡ بِالَّيۡلِ وَالنَّهَارِ مِنَ الرَّحۡمٰنِؕ بَلۡ هُمۡ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ مُّعۡرِضُوۡنَ
verses.en: Say, “Who will guard you, during night and day, against the RaHmān (All-Merciful, Allah)?” Rather, to the remembrance of their Lord they are averse.

verses.ar: اَمۡ لَهُمۡ اٰلِهَةٌ تَمۡنَعُهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِنَاؕ لَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ نَصۡرَ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ مِّنَّا يُصۡحَبُوۡنَ
verses.en: Or do they have gods who protect them besides Us? They are not able to help even themselves, nor will they have anyone to side with them against Us.

verses.ar: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡنَا هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ وَاٰبَآءَهُمۡ حَتّٰي طَالَ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡعُمُرُؕ اَفَلَا يَرَوۡنَ اَنَّا نَاۡتِي الۡاَرۡضَ نَنۡقُصُهَا مِنۡ اَطۡرَافِهَاؕ اَفَهُمُ الۡغٰلِبُوۡنَ
verses.en: But We have given benefits to these and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. So do they not see that We are coming to the land narrowing it down from all its sides? Then, are they the ones to prevail?

verses.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا٘ اُنۡذِرُكُمۡ بِالۡوَحۡيِؗۖ وَلَا يَسۡمَعُ الصُّمُّ الدُّعَآءَ اِذَا مَا يُنۡذَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Say, “I warn you only by revelation, but the deaf do not listen to the call when they are warned.”

verses.ar: وَلَئِنۡ مَّسَّتۡهُمۡ نَفۡحَةٌ مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ يٰوَيۡلَنَا٘ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: If a whiff of your Lord’s torment were to touch them, they would certainly say, “Alas to us! We were wrongdoers indeed.”

verses.ar: وَنَضَعُ الۡمَوَازِيۡنَ الۡقِسۡطَ لِيَوۡمِ الۡقِيٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٌ شَيۡـًٔاؕ وَاِنۡ كَانَ مِثۡقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنۡ خَرۡدَلٍ اَتَيۡنَا بِهَاؕ وَكَفٰي بِنَا حٰسِبِيۡنَ
verses.en: We shall place scales to do justice on the Day of Judgment. So no one shall be wronged in the least. Even if it (a deed) is to the measure of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth, and We are enough to take account.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسٰي وَهٰرُوۡنَ الۡفُرۡقَانَ وَضِيَآءً وَّذِكۡرًا لِّلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And We gave Mūsā and Hārūn the Criterion, and a light and an advice for the God-fearing,

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ بِالۡغَيۡبِ وَهُمۡ مِّنَ السَّاعَةِ مُشۡفِقُوۡنَ
verses.en: - those who have awe of their Lord without having seen Him, and are fearful of the Hour (of Judgment).

verses.ar: وَهٰذَا ذِكۡرٌ مُّبٰرَكٌ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُؕ اَفَاَنۡتُمۡ لَهٗ مُنۡكِرُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And this is a blessed advice We have sent down. Are you still rejecting it?

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا٘ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ رُشۡدَهٗ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَكُنَّا بِهٖ عٰلِمِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Even earlier We had given Ibrāhīm his right course, and We knew him well

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لِاَبِيۡهِ وَقَوۡمِهٖ مَا هٰذِهِ التَّمَاثِيۡلُ الَّتِيۡ٘ اَنۡتُمۡ لَهَا عٰكِفُوۡنَ
verses.en: when he said to his father and his people, “What are these statues you are devoted to?”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا وَجَدۡنَا٘ اٰبَآءَنَا لَهَا عٰبِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “We found our fathers worshipping them,”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَقَدۡ كُنۡتُمۡ اَنۡتُمۡ وَاٰبَآؤُكُمۡ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.en: He said, “Surely you and your fathers have been in open error.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اَجِئۡتَنَا بِالۡحَقِّ اَمۡ اَنۡتَ مِنَ اللّٰعِبِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “Did you come to us with truth or are you one of the triflers?”

verses.ar: قَالَ بَلۡ رَّبُّكُمۡ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ الَّذِيۡ فَطَرَهُنَّؗۖ وَاَنَا عَلٰي ذٰلِكُمۡ مِّنَ الشّٰهِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: He said, “No, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, who has created them, and I am one of those who bear witness to it.

verses.ar: وَتَاللّٰهِ لَاَكِيۡدَنَّ اَصۡنَامَكُمۡ بَعۡدَ اَنۡ تُوَلُّوۡا مُدۡبِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: And I swear by Allah that I will devise something against your idols after you have gone away turning your backs.”

verses.ar: فَجَعَلَهُمۡ جُذٰذًا اِلَّا كَبِيۡرًا لَّهُمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ اِلَيۡهِ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
verses.en: Then, he turned all of them into pieces, except the big one of them, so that they may come back to it.

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا مَنۡ فَعَلَ هٰذَا بِاٰلِهَتِنَا٘ اِنَّهٗ لَمِنَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “Who has done this to our gods? He is one of the wrongdoers indeed.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا سَمِعۡنَا فَتًي يَّذۡكُرُهُمۡ يُقَالُ لَهٗ٘ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمُؕ‏
verses.en: Some of them said, “We have heard a youth talking about them. He is called Ibrāhīm.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا فَاۡتُوۡا بِهٖ عَلٰ٘ي اَعۡيُنِ النَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَشۡهَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “Then, bring him before the eyes of the people, so that they may see”.

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا ءَاَنۡتَ فَعَلۡتَ هٰذَا بِاٰلِهَتِنَا يٰ٘اِبۡرٰهِيۡمُؕ‏
verses.en: They said, “Is it you O Ibrāhīm who has done this to our gods?”

verses.ar: قَالَ بَلۡ فَعَلَهٗࣗۖ كَبِيۡرُهُمۡ هٰذَا فَسۡـَٔلُوۡهُمۡ اِنۡ كَانُوۡا يَنۡطِقُوۡنَ
verses.en: He said, “Rather, this is done by this chief of theirs. So, ask them if they can speak.”

verses.ar: فَرَجَعُوۡ٘ا اِلٰ٘ي اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ فَقَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّكُمۡ اَنۡتُمُ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: So they turned to one another and said, “In fact, you yourselves are the wrongdoers.”

verses.ar: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوۡا عَلٰي رُءُوۡسِهِمۡۚ لَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتَ مَا هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ يَنۡطِقُوۡنَ
verses.en: Then, hanging their heads they reversed their position (and replied to Ibrāhīm,) “You already knew that they do not speak.”

verses.ar: قَالَ اَفَتَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا يَنۡفَعُكُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا وَّلَا يَضُرُّكُمۡؕ‏
verses.en: He said, “Do you then worship, beside Allah, what does neither benefit you in the least nor harm you?

verses.ar: اُفٍّ لَّكُمۡ وَلِمَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Fie upon you and upon what you worship other than Allah. Do you then not understand?”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا حَرِّقُوۡهُ وَانۡصُرُوۡ٘ا اٰلِهَتَكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ فٰعِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “(O people) burn him and help your gods, if you are to take action.”

verses.ar: قُلۡنَا يٰنَارُ كُوۡنِيۡ بَرۡدًا وَّسَلٰمًا عَلٰ٘ي اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَۙ‏
verses.en: We said, “O fire, be cold and safe for Ibrāhīm.”

verses.ar: وَاَرَادُوۡا بِهٖ كَيۡدًا فَجَعَلۡنٰهُمُ الۡاَخۡسَرِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: And they intended to harm him, but We made them the worst losers.

verses.ar: وَنَجَّيۡنٰهُ وَلُوۡطًا اِلَي الۡاَرۡضِ الَّتِيۡ بٰرَكۡنَا فِيۡهَا لِلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: And We rescued him and LūT towards the land we blessed for all the worlds.

verses.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهٗ٘ اِسۡحٰقَؕ وَيَعۡقُوۡبَ نَافِلَةًؕ وَكُلًّا جَعَلۡنَا صٰلِحِيۡنَ
verses.en: And We blessed him with IsHāq and Ya‘qūb as gift, and each one of them We made righteous.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ اَئِمَّةً يَّهۡدُوۡنَ بِاَمۡرِنَا وَاَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِمۡ فِعۡلَ الۡخَيۡرٰتِ وَاِقَامَ الصَّلٰوةِ وَاِيۡتَآءَ الزَّكٰوةِۚ وَكَانُوۡا لَنَا عٰبِدِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And We made them the Imams who guided (people) under Our command, and We inspired them to do good deeds and to establish Salāh and pay Zakāh, and Us alone they worshipped.

verses.ar: وَلُوۡطًا اٰتَيۡنٰهُ حُكۡمًا وَّعِلۡمًا وَّنَجَّيۡنٰهُ مِنَ الۡقَرۡيَةِ الَّتِيۡ كَانَتۡ تَّعۡمَلُ الۡخَبٰٓئِثَؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمَ سَوۡءٍ فٰسِقِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: As for LūT, We gave him wisdom and knowledge, and We delivered him from the town that used to do dirty deeds. Indeed, they were the people of evil, the sinners.

verses.ar: وَاَدۡخَلۡنٰهُ فِيۡ رَحۡمَتِنَاؕ اِنَّهٗ مِنَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And We admitted him to Our mercy. Indeed, He was of the righteous.

verses.ar: وَنُوۡحًا اِذۡ نَادٰي مِنۡ قَبۡلُ فَاسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهٗ فَنَجَّيۡنٰهُ وَاَهۡلَهٗ مِنَ الۡكَرۡبِ الۡعَظِيۡمِۚ‏
verses.en: And (remember) NūH, when he called (for help) earlier, so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the terrible agony,

verses.ar: وَنَصَرۡنٰهُ مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَاؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمَ سَوۡءٍ فَاَغۡرَقۡنٰهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ
verses.en: and helped him against the people who gave the lie to Our verses. Indeed, they were the people of evil, therefore, We drowned them all.

verses.ar: وَدَاوٗدَ وَسُلَيۡمٰنَ اِذۡ يَحۡكُمٰنِ فِي الۡحَرۡثِ اِذۡ نَفَشَتۡ فِيۡهِ غَنَمُ الۡقَوۡمِۚ وَكُنَّا لِحُكۡمِهِمۡ شٰهِدِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And (remember) Dawūd (David) and Sulaimān (Solomon), when they were adjudicating about the tillage in which the goats of other people wandered at night (and trampled it), and We were witness to their judgment.

verses.ar: فَفَهَّمۡنٰهَا سُلَيۡمٰنَۚ وَكُلًّا اٰتَيۡنَا حُكۡمًا وَّعِلۡمًاؗ وَّسَخَّرۡنَا مَعَ دَاوٗدَ الۡجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحۡنَ وَالطَّيۡرَؕ وَكُنَّا فٰعِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: So, We enabled Sulaimān to understand it. And to each one of them We gave wisdom and knowledge. And with Dawūd We subjugated the mountains that pronounced tasbīH (Allah’s purity), and the birds as well. And We were the One who did (it).

verses.ar: وَعَلَّمۡنٰهُ صَنۡعَةَ لَبُوۡسٍ لَّكُمۡ لِتُحۡصِنَكُمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَاۡسِكُمۡۚ فَهَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ شٰكِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: We taught him the skill of making armor as dress for you to protect you from what may harm you (in combat). So are you grateful?

verses.ar: وَلِسُلَيۡمٰنَ الرِّيۡحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجۡرِيۡ بِاَمۡرِهٖ٘ اِلَي الۡاَرۡضِ الَّتِيۡ بٰرَكۡنَا فِيۡهَاؕ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: And for Sulaimān, (We subjugated) the violent wind that blew under his command to the land in which We placed Our blessings. And We were the One who knew everything.

verses.ar: وَمِنَ الشَّيٰطِيۡنِ مَنۡ يَّغُوۡصُوۡنَ لَهٗ وَيَعۡمَلُوۡنَ عَمَلًا دُوۡنَ ذٰلِكَۚ وَكُنَّا لَهُمۡ حٰفِظِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And from the devils, (We subjugated for him) those who dived in water for him and did jobs other than that. And We were the One who kept watch over them.

verses.ar: وَاَيُّوۡبَ اِذۡ نَادٰي رَبَّهٗ٘ اَنِّيۡ مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَاَنۡتَ اَرۡحَمُ الرّٰحِمِيۡنَۚۖ‏
verses.en: And (remember) Ayyūb (Job), when he called his Lord saying, “Here I am, afflicted by pain and You are the most merciful of all the merciful.”

verses.ar: فَاسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهٗ فَكَشَفۡنَا مَا بِهٖ مِنۡ ضُرٍّ وَّاٰتَيۡنٰهُ اَهۡلَهٗ وَمِثۡلَهُمۡ مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةً مِّنۡ عِنۡدِنَا وَذِكۡرٰي لِلۡعٰبِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: So, We answered his prayer and removed whatever pain he had, and gave him (back) his family and the like thereof along with them, as a mercy from Our own Self and as a lesson for the worshippers.

verses.ar: وَاِسۡمٰعِيۡلَ وَاِدۡرِيۡسَ وَذَا الۡكِفۡلِؕ كُلٌّ مِّنَ الصّٰبِرِيۡنَۙۚۖ‏
verses.en: And (remember) Ismā‘īl and Idrīs and Dhul-Kifl. Each one of them was of those who observed patience.

verses.ar: وَاَدۡخَلۡنٰهُمۡ فِيۡ رَحۡمَتِنَاؕ اِنَّهُمۡ مِّنَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ
verses.en: And We admitted them to Our mercy. Surely, they were of the righteous.

verses.ar: وَذَا النُّوۡنِ اِذۡ ذَّهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا فَظَنَّ اَنۡ لَّنۡ نَّقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ فَنَادٰي فِي الظُّلُمٰتِ اَنۡ لَّا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡتَ سُبۡحٰنَكَࣗۖ اِنِّيۡ كُنۡتُ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَۚۖ‏
verses.en: And (remember) Dhunnūn (the man of the fish, namely Yūnus X), when he walked away in anger and thought that We would never put him to trouble. Then, he called (Us) in depths of darkness saying, “There is no god but You. Pure are You. Indeed I was among the wrongdoers”.

verses.ar: فَاسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهٗۙ وَنَجَّيۡنٰهُ مِنَ الۡغَمِّؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ نُۨجِي الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: So We responded to him and rescued him from the distress. And this is how We rescue the believers.

verses.ar: وَزَكَرِيَّا٘ اِذۡ نَادٰي رَبَّهٗ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرۡنِيۡ فَرۡدًا وَّاَنۡتَ خَيۡرُ الۡوٰرِثِيۡنَۚۖ‏
verses.en: And (remember) Zakariyyā when he called his Lord, “My Lord, do not leave me alone and You are the best of inheritors.”

verses.ar: فَاسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهٗؗ وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهٗ يَحۡيٰي وَاَصۡلَحۡنَا لَهٗ زَوۡجَهٗؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا يُسٰرِعُوۡنَ فِي الۡخَيۡرٰتِ وَيَدۡعُوۡنَنَا رَغَبًا وَّرَهَبًاؕ وَكَانُوۡا لَنَا خٰشِعِيۡنَ
verses.en: So, We responded to him and gave him YaHyā and made his wife good for him. They used to race towards the good deeds and call Us with hope and fear; and they were humble to Us.

verses.ar: وَالَّتِيۡ٘ اَحۡصَنَتۡ فَرۡجَهَا فَنَفَخۡنَا فِيۡهَا مِنۡ رُّوۡحِنَا وَجَعَلۡنٰهَا وَابۡنَهَا٘ اٰيَةً لِّلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: And (remember) her who protected her private part (that is, Maryam). So, We blew in her (a life) through Our Spirit, and made her and her son (‘Īsā X) a sign for all the worlds.

verses.ar: اِنَّ هٰذِهٖ٘ اُمَّتُكُمۡ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةًؗۖ وَّاَنَا رَبُّكُمۡ فَاعۡبُدُوۡنِ
verses.en: Surely, this is the fraternity of your Faith, a single Faith, and I am your Lord; so worship Me.

verses.ar: وَتَقَطَّعُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرَهُمۡ بَيۡنَهُمۡؕ كُلٌّ اِلَيۡنَا رٰجِعُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: But they have separated their ways from one another. All of them have to return to Us.

verses.ar: فَمَنۡ يَّعۡمَلۡ مِنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٌ فَلَا كُفۡرَانَ لِسَعۡيِهٖۚ وَاِنَّا لَهٗ كٰتِبُوۡنَ
verses.en: So, whoever does righteous deeds, while he is a believer, his effort will not be rejected, and We are to put it on record.

verses.ar: وَحَرٰمٌ عَلٰي قَرۡيَةٍ اَهۡلَكۡنٰهَا٘ اَنَّهُمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
verses.en: It is banned for (the people of) a town that We destroyed that they come back

verses.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا فُتِحَتۡ يَاۡجُوۡجُ وَمَاۡجُوۡجُ وَهُمۡ مِّنۡ كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَّنۡسِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: until when the Ya’jūj and Ma’jūj (Gog and Magog) are released, while they run down from every height,

verses.ar: وَاقۡتَرَبَ الۡوَعۡدُ الۡحَقُّ فَاِذَا هِيَ شَاخِصَةٌ اَبۡصَارُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡاؕ يٰوَيۡلَنَا قَدۡ كُنَّا فِيۡ غَفۡلَةٍ مِّنۡ هٰذَا بَلۡ كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: and the True Promise draws near, then it will so happen that the eyes of the disbelievers shall remain upraised (in terror, and they will say,) “Alas to us! We were in negligence about this; rather we were transgressors.”

verses.ar: اِنَّكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَؕ اَنۡتُمۡ لَهَا وٰرِدُوۡنَ
verses.en: Surely, you and whatever you worship other than Allah are the fuel of Jahannam.. There you will have to arrive.

verses.ar: لَوۡ كَانَ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ اٰلِهَةً مَّا وَرَدُوۡهَاؕ وَكُلٌّ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ
verses.en: Had they been gods, they would not have arrived at it, and all of them will remain there forever.

verses.ar: لَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا زَفِيۡرٌ وَّهُمۡ فِيۡهَا لَا يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: For them, there will be screams in it and they will not hear.

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ سَبَقَتۡ لَهُمۡ مِّنَّا الۡحُسۡنٰ٘يۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ عَنۡهَا مُبۡعَدُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: As for those for whom the good (news) from Us has come earlier, they will be kept far away from it.

verses.ar: لَا يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ حَسِيۡسَهَاۚ وَهُمۡ فِيۡ مَا اشۡتَهَتۡ اَنۡفُسُهُمۡ خٰلِدُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: They will not hear the slightest of its sound, and they will remain forever in what their souls desire.

verses.ar: لَا يَحۡزُنُهُمُ الۡفَزَعُ الۡاَكۡبَرُ وَتَتَلَقّٰىهُمُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُؕ هٰذَا يَوۡمُكُمُ الَّذِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: They shall not be grieved by the Biggest Panic, and the angels shall receive them (saying), “This is your day that you had been promised”

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ نَطۡوِي السَّمَآءَ كَطَيِّ السِّجِلِّ لِلۡكُتُبِؕ كَمَا بَدَاۡنَا٘ اَوَّلَ خَلۡقٍ نُّعِيۡدُهٗؕ وَعۡدًا عَلَيۡنَاؕ اِنَّا كُنَّا فٰعِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: - the Day when We roll up the sky like a scroll rolls up the writings. Just as We originated the first creation, so We shall bring it back again - a promise (undertaken to be binding) on Us. We are sure to do it.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ كَتَبۡنَا فِي الزَّبُوۡرِ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ الذِّكۡرِ اَنَّ الۡاَرۡضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ الصّٰلِحُوۡنَ
verses.en: And We have written in Zabūr (Psalms) after the advice that the land will be inherited by My righteous slaves.

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ هٰذَا لَبَلٰغًا لِّقَوۡمٍ عٰبِدِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Surely, in this (Qur’ān) there is a message conveyed to a people who worship (Allah).

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنٰكَ اِلَّا رَحۡمَةً لِّلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: And We have not sent you but as mercy for all the worlds.

verses.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا يُوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيَّ اَنَّمَا٘ اِلٰهُكُمۡ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌۚ فَهَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ مُّسۡلِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Say, “What is revealed to me is simply that your God is One God. So do you submit?”

verses.ar: فَاِنۡ تَوَلَّوۡا فَقُلۡ اٰذَنۡتُكُمۡ عَلٰي سَوَآءٍؕ وَاِنۡ اَدۡرِيۡ٘ اَقَرِيۡبٌ اَمۡ بَعِيۡدٌ مَّا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: But, if they turn away, then say (to them), “I have warned you all alike, and I do not know whether what you have been warned of is near or far.

verses.ar: اِنَّهٗ يَعۡلَمُ الۡجَهۡرَ مِنَ الۡقَوۡلِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تَكۡتُمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Surely, He knows what is spoken openly and He knows what you conceal.

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ اَدۡرِيۡ لَعَلَّهٗ فِتۡنَةٌ لَّكُمۡ وَمَتَاعٌ اِلٰي حِيۡنٍ
verses.en: And I do not know; perhaps it is a trial for you and an enjoyment for a while.”

verses.ar: قٰلَ رَبِّ احۡكُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّؕ وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحۡمٰنُ الۡمُسۡتَعَانُ عَلٰي مَا تَصِفُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: He (Our Messenger) said, “My Lord, judge with truth. And Our Lord is the RaHmān (All-Merciful), the One whose help is sought against what you describe.
